description: Coyote property (any world, --pads=1): Pip stands grounded (coyote timer full), a DEV TELEPORT lifts him 1.5 m into the air (equivalent to the frame after walking off a ledge: airborne, coyote running), and jump is pressed 8 frames (~133 ms < 200 ms coyote) later. PASS = EVT jumped fires while airborne. Then a control: after landing and waiting out the window (>0.20 s airborne via a second lift), a jump pressed 30 frames (~500 ms) after leaving ground must NOT fire.
